text: Code reviews are a critical practice for any software development team. By having another developer examine your code, you can catch bugs early, before they become expensive problems in production. However, the benefits go beyond simple error detection. They are also a powerful tool for knowledge sharing; junior developers learn from senior ones, and everyone gains a deeper understanding of the codebase. This process builds a culture of shared ownership, where the quality of the code is a team responsibility, not just an individual one. Ultimately, regular code reviews lead to more reliable software and a stronger, more collaborative team.
